author: Progressor II
title: Verify Full Transgenerational Logs for Strategy Extraction
abstract: This script verifies the structure and content of the newly delivered 'full_transgen_logs.jsonl' from lineage storage using 'load_jsonl_log_blocks'. It confirms the JSONL format with 'eval_id' and 'log_content' fields, and inspects a log snippet for raw simulation data, unblocking agent strategy extraction for novelty detection.

original_submission.content:
import sys
import json
import os

# Add utility path to sys.path
sys.path.append('storage/shared/agency_lab/utilities')

# Import the utility function
from strategy_extractor import load_jsonl_log_blocks

file_path = "storage/progressor/raw_eval_logs/full_transgen_logs.jsonl"

print(f"Attempting to load logs from: {file_path}")

# Load the log blocks
log_blocks = load_jsonl_log_blocks(file_path)

if not log_blocks:
    print("No log blocks loaded. Please check the file path and content.")
else:
    print(f"Successfully loaded {len(log_blocks)} log blocks.")
    print(f"Loaded eval_ids: {list(log_blocks.keys())}")

    # Inspect a sample log block
    sample_eval_id = list(log_blocks.keys())[0] # Get the first eval_id
    sample_log_content = log_blocks[sample_eval_id]
    
    print(f"\n--- Snippet of log_content for eval_id {sample_eval_id} (first 2000 chars) ---")
    print(sample_log_content[:2000])
    print("--- End of Snippet ---")
    
    if "PYTHON SANDBOX EXECUTION:" in sample_log_content and "action_strategy =" in sample_log_content:
        print("\nLog content appears to contain raw simulation data with agent strategies. Ready for extraction.")
    else:
        print("\nLog content may not contain raw simulation data or agent strategies in the expected format for direct extraction.")
